open_science_requirements: Training activities must integrate key transferable skills and competences common to all fields, including digital skills (e.g. generative AI), and must foster the culture of Open Science, knowledge valorisation, innovation and entrepreneurship where applicable, and good scientific conduct including research integrity. (CC-09, Scope; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json)

Training activities implemented under the fellowship must integrate key transferable skills and competences (including digital skills such as generative AI), foster Open Science culture, knowledge valorisation, and good scientific conduct including research integrity. (SR-04, Scope; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json)

A Career Development Plan covering research objectives, training and career needs (including transferable skills, teaching, publications, conferences, and Open Science activities) must be established jointly by the supervisor(s) and the researcher, and submitted as a project deliverable at the beginning of the action. (CC-10, Scope; HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01-01.slice.json)
